title: Cohort-driven rerank evaluation harness with streaming telemetry and A/B hooks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a horizontally scalable evaluation harness that computes per-cohort NDCG and MRR for live reranking traffic, ties metrics back to customer prompt sets, and exposes A/B testing hooks for Canary/experiment comparisons. The harness should be low-overhead (target <20ms added latency on tail), support streaming ingestion from the rerank endpoint, and produce both real-time rolling windows and daily aggregation snapshots. This ticket covers instrumentation changes in the rerank API to emit sample identifiers and cohort tags, a streaming compute pipeline to calculate ranking metrics, a lightweight store for recent promptset-based aggregates, and an integration point for the Console to visualize experiment deltas and statistical significance. Privacy: promptsets may contain customer PII; the pipeline must support PII redaction and adhere to KMS encryption-at-rest policies.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming pipeline computes per-customer and per-cohort NDCG@10 and MRR in rolling 1h windows and stores daily snapshots
Rerank API emits sample_id, promptset_id, and cohort_tag headers with >99.9% coverage for instrumented requests
A/B experiment hook allows tagging requests and the Console shows delta NDCG/MRR with p-values for binomial/sign test
End-to-end added latency at the rerank request path is <20ms p95 and CPU/GPU overhead is negligible
System scales to 10k active promptsets with bounded memory growth (operational runbook included)
Telemetry respects PII redaction and integrates with KMS-backed storage for historical snapshots
metrics: Target NDCG/MRR collection latency: <5s for rolling window updates, <60s for near-real-time dashboarding
Ingestion success rate: >=99.9% for instrumented rerank events
A/B experiment detection sensitivity: detect 0.5 NDCG point change with 80% power at n=10k requests
End-to-end CPU overhead: <3% of rerank worker CPU at typical load
Scale target: sustain 50k rerank requests/sec total across clusters with sampling and aggregation offload
implementation_notes: Instrumentation: add optional header fields (X-Rerank-Sample-Id, X-Promptset-Id, X-Cohort-Tag) and secure logging flag to rerank API; fall back to hashed promptset fingerprint if explicit id absent
Streaming layer: implement Flink job to compute incremental NDCG/MRR per (customer, promptset, cohort) using keyed windows; use Kafka topic 'rerank-events' as source
Aggregation store: store daily snapshots in encrypted Parquet on object storage and expose recent 7-day aggregates in a compact Redis cache for Console queries
AB hooks: support random assignment and deterministic bucketing for experiments; emit experiment_id into streamed events to enable parallel experiment analysis
Backfill: provide a bounded backfill job that can reprocess 7 days of events from raw logs to recompute aggregates after metric changes
Privacy & security: perform PII tokenization before events enter the public topics; ensure all persisted aggregates are encrypted with customer KMS keys where applicable
Observability: expose per-partition processing lag, event drop rate, and window completeness metrics to Console; alert on >1% data loss or >30s processing lag
Testing: unit tests for metric computations (pairwise and rank-based), e2e tests with synthetic promptsets, and a canary rollout path on Dedicated with traffic shaping
